added_claim_errors: 「内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」: that provision does not itself impose the claimed itemization requirement.
「室内の写真は当方でも保管しております」: invents an existing photographic record the user never mentioned.
「少額調停」: based on general legal knowledge, this is not the formal procedure name; civil mediation and small-claims litigation are distinct.
「壁紙の残存価値はゼロ」「仮に借主負担が生じる場合でも…負担額は0円」: the residual value is 1 yen, approximately zero; depreciation does not categorically eliminate labor or construction charges for tenant-caused damage.
「具体的に書かれ、重要事項説明でその説明を受けていた…事情がない限り」: misleadingly presents written specification plus an important-matters explanation as necessary; the key recognizes alternative ways to establish clear agreement.
「日焼けの程度を示せるのはあなただけ」: unsupported exclusivity; inspection records and other evidence can also establish the condition.
「費用対効果は十分あります」: asserts litigation is worthwhile without knowing the costs, evidence, or user's circumstances.

reasons: Both immediately reject the mistaken obligation to pay and correctly identify sunlight discoloration as ordinary wear. B narrowly wins because its email expressly refuses the charge and requests the full 100,000-yen deposit, while A merely postpones settlement. B nevertheless makes a material error by treating depreciation as eliminating every possible charge; A invents a statutory itemization requirement and an existing photo record. Both omit the 20,000-yen additional-payment warning, fail to request move-in records, and are longer than necessary.
